Its{{sic}} do or die!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 ([[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Spirit''' was a major boss that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as the final boss of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though it copies the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] [[Frost Spirit]] statistics there. It moved at an extremely slow pace, but had one million health, surpassing every enemy's health in the game at the time. The '''Frost Spirit''' had four abilities. #Its first ability was its ''Frostbite Slam'' attack, which froze towers hit, meaning that they could not attack. #Its second ability, its ''Nausea Stomp'' attack, caused towers' firerate to be increased by an 150% [[Fatigue Debuff]], thereby making them shoot slower. #Its third ability was its ''Antarctic Mist'' attack. This attack caused the '''Frost Spirit''' to breathe cold mist, freezing any towers caught in the breath. This attack also dealt damage to [[units]], 450 damage per tick. #Its fourth and final ability was ''Flying Frost'', a variant of a Rage Mode. During this state, its wings caused it to be lifted a short distance off the ground, increasing its speed. None of these abilities work in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Frost Spirit''' has black reflective skin, while its torso and legs are dark blue marble. It wears a blue-grey robe, hood, complete a furry collar, and boots. It has light blue wings which it can use to fly a short distance above the ground during its ability. Neon blue spikes can be seen on its shoulders and above its head was a neon blue halo. Black chains are wrapped around its legs, arms and wings. Around its neck, it wears a chain with a grey lock on it. It also has menacing neon blue eyes. The '''Frost Spirit''' wields a scythe to attack towers. Chains run along the top of the scythe and the blade was neon blue. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *You can use [[Turret]]s, [[Accelerator]]s, [[Pursuit]]s and [[Ranger]]s to take down the '''Frost Spirit''' and other enemies that spawn before it. This is recommended due to the '''Frost Spirit's''' high health. **The [[Commander]]'s '''Call to Arms''' ability can be useful in boosting these towers' firerate, allowing more damage to be done over time. ***The [[Commander]] also allows you to mitigate the effects of the ''Nausea Stomp'', as it cancels out the increase in firerate. **As the '''Frost Spirit''' is likely going to get out of your towers' range, especially if they are placed near the start of the map, you should use the [[DJ Booth]] to boost the range of these towers. *The '''Frost Spirit''' will always use the middle left path, relative to the direction that enemies move towards. **You should sell towers on the right paths that do not reach the middle left path. You should also sell towers that the '''Frost Spirit''' has moved out of range of. **You should also sell towers that deal damage to multiple enemies, like the [[Rocketeer]], if you have towers that deal more DPS to a singular enemy, like the [[Minigunner]], as the '''Frost Spirit''' does not spawn any enemies. *The [[Military Base]] is not recommended against the '''Frost Spirit''', as it is unlikely that its [[units]] will collide with the '''Frost Spirit''', or even be in range of the '''Frost Spirit''' as its [[units]] can spawn on different paths, which may not be on the same path as the '''Frost Spirit'''. *As with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Frost Spirit''' (though normal damage is not doubled). **However, as the [[Pyromancer]] speeds up enemies when they are on fire, you should sell any [[Pyromancer]]s remaining when it is just the '''Frost Spirit''' alive. *The [[Medic]] cannot cleanse towers if they are frozen, nor is it immune to being frozen by the '''Frost Spirit'''. **The [[Gladiator]] cannot block any of the '''Frost Spirit's''' attacks, even though the blocking animation plays. *After the '''Frost Spirit''' activates its ''Flying Frost'' ability, it will hover in the air a short distance above the path. **However, [[units]] will still be able to collide with it as it is not technically a [[Flying]] enemy. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:LordSinisterFire.ogg]] |When the '''Frost Spirit''' performs ''Antarctic Mist'' ability |- |[[File:Frost_Spirit_Rage.ogg]] |When the '''Frost Spirit''' performs ''Flying Frost'' ability |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FrostSpiritStomp.gif|Current ''Nausea Stomp'' animation (8 May 2021 – Present). WinterMatchmakingDI.png|'''Frost Spirit''' on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Frost Spirit''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} Winter2020.png|'''Frost Spirit''' on the [https://www.roblox.com/badges/2124652180/Frost-Invasion-2021%20Frost%20Invasion%202021 Frost Invasion 2021] badge. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionFrostSpiritIconIG.png|'''Frost Spirit''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Spirit's''' wings are the {{RLinkC|4585770651|Chained Angel Wings}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Frost Spirit''' is the first boss in the game to reach 1,000,000 base health, followed by [[The Umbra]]. **Although the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] is older and reaches up to 1,200,000 base health, that enemy did not have that much health until [[V1.2.1]] which was released well after the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. *The '''Frost Spirit's''' ''Antarctic Mist'' ability is similar to [[Lord Sinister]]'s ''Infernal Storm'' ability. **If you look closely at the animation, you can see him take the pose of [[Lord Sinister]], which means the animation was directly re-used. *When the '''Frost Spirit''' activates its ''Flying Frost'' ability, the animation may stutter. *The '''Frost Spirit''' depicted on the {{RLinkB|2124652180|Frost Invasion 2021 Badge}} has a golden halo, whilst the one in-game had a neon blue one. *The '''Frost Spirit's''' cape is the {{RLinkC|4750332993|Frost Lord Cape}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Frost Spirit''' returned in the [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E]] event, which is a retelling of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. *The '''Frost Spirit''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' -
